digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge tracker sync command surface
propositions: Six CLI verbs exist today; two are dead (`bridge-status` producer never existed, `purge-bridge` has no caller) and must be removed with no alias to prevent silent behavior changes
The `--mode` enum conflates two orthogonal concepts (change magnitude vs. bridge permissibility) and must be split into `--max-changes` and pause/resume flags
rebar core shells out to `gh` for safety precondition in fsck_repair.py, violating portability for clients without GitHub Actions; `gh` binary must be eliminated from all documented operations
106 lines of tracker push logic exist in GHA workflow that re-implements and diverges from `_store/push.py`; they must be reconciled and deleted
Bridge must run identically on local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare environments; contract test must verify no vendor variables are read and shallow clones are rejected
Pause state must be remote-persisted with reason, versioned for fleet mixed-version safety, and reader-ships-first before writer emits new format
